title: platyluma calophylloides
intro: Platyluma calophylloides, commonly known as Wild Jasmine, is a plant species in the family Lamiaceae. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, that can aid in the reduction of stress and improvement of overall well-being. The therapeutic actions of Platyluma calophylloides include its ability to act as an anxiolytic and a sedative, helping to calm the mind and promote relaxation. The bioactive constituents of this plant include diterpenoids and sesquiterpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
